## What it is

Goulotte / pont de test pour fils Helutherm, réduite à un seul logement d'aimant : un segment de canal droit, le plot pour un aimant 8×3 mm, puis le même segment droit après. U de 10 × 10 mm internes. Imprimée ouverte vers le haut ; on la retourne pour coller la face 0,6 mm sur le châssis métal.

## Contexte projet

- Même atelier que le boîtier : A1 Mini, PLA HT recuit, aimants 8×3 mm, fond de puit 0,6 mm.
- Puits du canal légèrement plus larges que ceux du boîtier (8,2 vs 8,15) : le disque doit glisser jusqu'au fond d'un puit profond. 8,4 était trop lâche (l'aimant ressortait en retournant la pièce) ; 8,2 testé et confirmé via `canal_test`.
- Cible : goulottes 230 V / Grove de la roadmap `../README.md`.

## Design notes

Printed as a U on the bed (open +Z). One trapezoid pad, centered on the channel, fuses into the wall: a solid margin around the well, then angled returns back to the channel on both sides. The well is a vertical cylinder from the bed up to a 0.6 mm bridged face. Flip onto the chassis: open rim and magnet face meet the metal.

Default `puit_diametre` 8.2 mm (see `puit_diametre_canal` in measurements). The box keeps 8.15 for its shallow friction wells; do not unify them. Walls 1.6 mm.

`segment_longueur` (default 20 mm) is the straight channel length on each side of the pad, not to the well center: the well sits at the middle of the channel, and each side is `segment_longueur + puit_diametre/2 + marge_puit + retour_biais` long. Total channel length is `2 * segment_longueur + 2 * (puit_diametre/2 + marge_puit + retour_biais)`.

`ouverture_ouest` and `ouverture_est` (default 0, off) each cut a notch through the wall opposite the well (the outer, non-magnet side), flush with the west (low X) or east (high X) end of the channel. Cables exit sideways there.

`min_wall = 0.6` is intentional for the magnet faces.

## Don't

- Do not run a full-length magnet rail. The pad stays local around the well.
- Do not put the magnet well in the U floor.
- Do not tighten the canal well all the way back to the box 8.15: deep wells still need some extra clearance to seat the disc on the 0.6 mm face. 8.2 is confirmed good; go no tighter without a fresh `canal_test`.
- Do not thicken the 0.6 mm magnet face for the default min_wall.
- Do not close the ends. Wires enter and leave along X.
- Do not print this the use way up.
- Do not drop `epaisseur_paroi` under about 1.2 mm on a 100 mm run.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 0.6
```

## Changelog

- Split `ouverture` into `ouverture_ouest`/`ouverture_est`, both default 0 (no notch) so David can choose which end gets the cable-exit slot.
- Reduced to a single magnet well: `aimants`/`longueur`/`marge_extremite` replaced by `segment_longueur` (straight run on each side of the one pad). David no longer needs the multi-magnet 170 mm version.
- Tightened `puit_diametre` to 8.2 mm (from 8.4): confirmed via `canal_test` after 8.4 let the magnet fall out on flipping.
- Added `ouverture`: cable-exit notch flush with the near end of the channel, on the wall opposite the wells.
- Extended to 170 mm; end pads pinned 10 mm from each channel end via `marge_extremite`.
- Local magnet pads with angled returns; well Ø 8.4 mm for deep insertion.
- First test coupon: 10×10×100 mm U.
